entities.name: Nemanja Djurišić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nemanja Đurišić is a Montenegrin professional basketball player for Mitteldeutscher BC of the German Basketball Bundesliga (BBL). Đurišić is also currently a member of the Montenegrin national team and during his college years he played for the University of Georgia in the United States. He can play both small or power forward position. He is one of the few players from Montenegro who completed all 4 years of basketball scholarship at a university in the United States.
